brief: Escape text for use in a regular expression
description: Returns value with every character that could have a meaning in a regular expression escaped, so that the result matches value itself, as ECMAScript's RegExp.escape(s) does. Use it to put data in a pattern: to_regexp("^" + regexp_escape(name) + "\\z"). ASCII letters, digits, _ and characters above ASCII are kept, except a leading digit and white space, which are written as \x{hh}, as are control characters; every other ASCII character gets a backslash. The result means the same with any flags.
